criteria.naming_rule: A community gets a descriptive name only if (1) the whole-graph modularity passes the random-graph check, (2) it contains at least one Wish node, and (3) EVERY member has co-association confidence >= 0.80 over 100 Louvain seeds. Otherwise it is shown by its Community number only. The name is just the Wish labels inside it.

null_model.description: Wish-Deity edges and Deity-Place edges rewired separately; every node keeps its degree in each relation.
